<function name="SelectedItemPaintOver" parent="MatSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>Defines a paint over function for a <page>DImageButton</page> when it is selected.

<warning>`self` in the context of this function is the <page>DImageButton</page>!</warning>
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2023.09.08</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="w" type="number">Width of the <page>DImageButton</page> panel.</arg>
		<arg name="h" type="number">Height of the <page>DImageButton</page> panel.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
